eventDetail.scope: The 2027 2nd International Conference on Aerospace, Intelligent Perception and Control (AIPC 2027) will explore the rapidly advancing fields of intelligent systems, perception technologies, and control methodologies for aerospace and autonomous applications. The conference highlights developments in intelligent perception, artificial intelligence, machine learning, autonomous systems, control theory, robotics, and cyber-physical systems, with a focus on enabling reliable sensing, decision-making, and intelligent control in complex environments. By bringing together researchers, engineers, and industry professionals, AIPC 2027 aims to promote the exchange of innovative ideas, foster interdisciplinary collaboration, and advance emerging technologies that contribute to the development of intelligent aerospace systems and autonomous applications.
